title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 5.2 Power Functions and Polynomial Functions: Identify power functions.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 5.2 Power Functions and Polynomial Functions: Identify power functions.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "5.2 Power Functions and Polynomial Functions", prints these objectives: "Identify power functions." "Identify end behavior of power functions." "Identify polynomial functions." "Identify the degree and leading coefficient of polynomial functions.". The section text says: "Suppose a certain species of bird thrives on a small island. Its population over the last few years is shown in Table 1 ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
